ArtworkSelection.description: Which candidate is picked automatically per artwork kind (S9d4a).

preset.description: How the automatic choice is made among candidates.
preset.help: `best_rated` picks the highest-rated candidate (TMDb `vote_average`, `vote_count` as tiebreak). `random_top_n` picks one of the top N candidates — deterministically: the same item, kind and reshuffle count always give the same image; use the Reshuffle button to change it.
preset.title: Preset

top_n.description: How many of the best candidates `random_top_n` may choose from.
top_n.help: For the `random_top_n` preset: how many of the best-ranked candidates are eligible for the (deterministic) pick. Default 3.
top_n.title: Top N

ArtworkSelection.title: ArtworkSelection

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the fanart.tv API key.
api_key_env.help: Env var name holding your fanart.tv key (not the key itself). Get one at https://www.fanart.tv/user/apikey. Optional.
api_key_env.title: Api Key Env

enabled.description: Enable fanart.tv as an artwork source.
enabled.help: Turn fanart.tv on/off. Off by default; useful for extra logos and landscape art. Requires a fanart.tv key to be set.
enabled.title: Enabled

genres.help: Only include items with any of these genres (case-insensitive, match any). Empty = any genre.
genres.title: Genres

min_rating.help: Only include items rated at least this high (on a 0-10 scale, matching the rating Finmeta computes). Empty = no minimum.
min_rating.title: Min Rating

year_from.help: Only include items released in this year or later. Empty = no lower bound.
year_from.title: Year From

year_to.help: Only include items released in this year or earlier. Empty = no upper bound.
year_to.title: Year To

filter.help: The filter (year range, min rating, genres) that selects which library items belong to this collection. Required for `filter` collections.

library.description: Library this collection is built from.
library.help: The library (key from `libraries`) whose items are used to build this collection. Must reference a configured library.
library.title: Library

name.help: The name shown in Jellyfin for this collection. Must be unique among collections you define.
name.title: Name

type.help: Fixed value `filter`. Builds a collection from library items that match the `filter`. The `filter` is required for this type.
type.title: Type

enabled.description: Enable IMDb bulk datasets as a ratings source.
enabled.help: Turn the IMDb bulk dataset on/off. Off by default. Downloads IMDb's `title.ratings.tsv.gz` (at most once per 24h), indexes it by tconst and provides the IMDb rating + vote count with no API key. Note: this is the IMDb non-commercial dataset — see the IMDb datasets help in the External services tab for the licence.
enabled.title: Enabled

filter.description: Optional filter applied to the library items.
filter.help: Optional constraints (year range, min rating, genres) applied on top of the library. Required for `filter`-type collections; ignored for `tmdb_collection`.

library.description: Library this collection is built from.
library.help: The library (key from `libraries`) whose items are used to build this collection. Must reference a configured library.
library.title: Library

name.help: The name shown in Jellyfin for this collection. Must be unique among collections you define.
name.title: Name

tmdb_ids.description: List of TMDb item ids to include.
tmdb_ids.help: Explicit TMDb numeric ids to include, e.g. `[27205, 157336, 155]`. Each is matched against library items; unmatched ids are skipped.
tmdb_ids.title: Tmdb Ids

type.description: Collection type discriminator (explicit TMDb id list).
type.help: Fixed value `list`. Builds a collection from an explicit list of TMDb ids. Useful for curated, hand-picked collections.
type.title: Type

enabled.description: Enable the local asset directory as an artwork source.
enabled.help: Use artwork files you place on disk (e.g. hand-made overlays or theme songs). Off by default. See `path` for where to put them.
enabled.title: Enabled

path.help: Directory (in the local filesystem) where you drop your own artwork assets. Only used when the local source is enabled. In the shipped container this is typically `/config/assets`.
path.title: Path

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the MDBList API key.
api_key_env.help: Env var name holding your MDBList API key (not the key itself). Set the key via that env var or in Settings. Get a key at https://api.mdblist.com. Free tier is 1,000 requests/day.
api_key_env.title: Api Key Env

enabled.description: Enable MDBList as a ratings source.
enabled.help: Turn MDBList on/off. Off by default. Aggregates IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes (critic + audience), Metacritic, Trakt, Letterboxd and TMDb ratings in one call. Requires an API key (the `mdblist_key` secret or env var MDBLIST_KEY). Responses are cached with a 7 day TTL and the client is rate-limit aware.
enabled.title: Enabled

api_key.description: Name of the secret holding this instance's API key.
api_key.help: The *name* of the secret that holds this instance's API key (e.g. `radarr_key`). The key value is set in Settings and never stored here — only this name lives in the config.
api_key.title: Api Key

enabled.description: Include this instance in Sonarr/Radarr operations.
enabled.help: Turn this instance on/off without removing it. Disabled instances are skipped by the Sonarr/Radarr integration but still show up in Settings.
enabled.title: Enabled

name.help: A unique name for this Sonarr/Radarr instance, e.g. `Radarr` or `Sonarr4K`. Used to identify the instance and to look up the secret holding its API key.
name.title: Name

timeout.help: How long to wait, in seconds, for each request to this instance before giving up (default 30).
timeout.title: Timeout

url.help: The address of this Sonarr/Radarr instance, e.g. `http://192.168.1.10:7878`. Same container/`localhost` caveat as the Jellyfin URL: inside a container use the LAN IP or the container name.
url.title: Url

verify_ssl.description: Verify TLS certificates for https connections.
verify_ssl.help: Verify the server's TLS certificate for `https` URLs (default on). Turn off only for a trusted self-signed cert.
verify_ssl.title: Verify Ssl

radarr.help: Your Radarr instances (e.g. `Radarr`, `Radarr4K`). Each has a url, the name of the secret holding its API key, timeout, verify_ssl and enabled.
radarr.title: Radarr

sonarr.help: Your Sonarr instances (e.g. `Sonarr`, `Sonarr4K`). Each has a url, the name of the secret holding its API key, timeout, verify_ssl and enabled.
sonarr.title: Sonarr

enabled.description: Write a sidecar .nfo with metadata for this library.
enabled.help: When on, Finmeta writes a metadata NFO (title, overview, rating, genres, etc.) next to each item. On by default. Disable to leave metadata untouched.
enabled.title: Enabled

fields.description: Which metadata fields to write (None = the sensible default set).
fields.help: Restrict which metadata fields go into the NFO, e.g. `[title, overview, rating]`. Leave empty/null for the default set (title, originaltitle, overview, tagline, year, genres, studios, rating). Unknown field names are an error.
fields.title: Fields

backdrop.help: Write a `fanart.jpg`/backdrop (the 16:9 landscape artwork). Off by default.
backdrop.title: Backdrop

landscape.help: Write a `landscape.jpg`. Distinct from `backdrop` on some layouts. Off by default.
landscape.title: Landscape

logo.help: Write a `logo.png` (transparent title logo). Off by default. Mostly useful for TV; rarely available for movies.
logo.title: Logo

poster.help: Write a `poster.jpg` next to the movie (the 2:3 main artwork). Off by default; turn on to have Finmeta manage posters.
poster.title: Poster

artwork.help: Movie artwork options (poster, backdrop, logo, landscape). See each option's help.

artwork_selection.description: Per-library automatic artwork selection (None = inherit global).
artwork_selection.help: Override the global `artwork_selection` for this library. Leave unset to inherit the global preset/top_n.

artwork_write_method.description: Per-library artwork write method override (None = inherit global).
artwork_write_method.help: `sidecar` is the only write method (see the global `artwork_write_method` for why `jellyfin_api` was removed 2026-10-26) -- this override can no longer actually differ from the global setting. Kept only so an older config.yml with this key already set keeps loading.
artwork_write_method.title: Artwork Write Method

enabled.description: Whether this library is managed at all.
enabled.help: Turn this library on/off. Libraries that appear in Jellyfin but are not mentioned in config stay off and untouched (anime libraries included). Default `false` so a newly added Jellyfin library never gets written to until you explicitly enable it.
enabled.title: Enabled

metadata.help: Controls whether and what metadata NFO is written for this library (enabled + which fields). See Metadata help.

overlay_profile.description: Name of the overlay profile applied to this library's items.
overlay_profile.help: Which named overlay profile (from `overlays.profiles`) is applied to this library's items during plan/apply. A profile supplies the overlay element list plus per-element style/format-rule overrides. Leave unset for no overlays at all. Unknown names are a config error.
overlay_profile.title: Overlay Profile

overlays.description: Deprecated: overlay element names (use overlay_profile instead).
overlays.help: Deprecated (S9d4c). Kept only so older configs keep loading: at config-load time, a non-empty list here with no profile (or a profile with no `elements`) is migrated into an auto-generated profile `<library>-auto` holding this list, assigned via `overlay_profile`. From then on only the profile is read. Set `overlay_profile` + `overlays.profiles` directly instead of this list in new configs.
overlays.title: Overlays

poster_rotation.description: Scheduled poster reshuffle for this library's top-rated items.
poster_rotation.help: Off by default. See PosterRotation help.

theme_song.description: Copy the show's theme song from the local asset dir.
theme_song.help: Place a theme song for each show, sourced from the local asset directory only (v1 does not download from YouTube — see SPEC override O2). Off by default.
theme_song.title: Theme Song

type.help: Fixed value `movies`. Tells Finmeta this library is a movie library and selects the movie artwork options.
type.title: Type

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the OMDb API key.
api_key_env.help: Env var name holding your OMDb API key (not the key itself). Set the key via that env var or in Settings. Get a free key at https://www.omdbapi.com/apikey.aspx.
api_key_env.title: Api Key Env

enabled.description: Enable OMDb as a ratings source.
enabled.help: Turn OMDb on/off. Off by default. Provides IMDb rating, Rotten Tomatoes critic score and Metacritic score. Requires an API key (the `omdb_key` secret or env var OMDB_KEY). Responses are cached with a 7 day TTL. Get a key at https://www.omdbapi.com/apikey.aspx.
enabled.title: Enabled

bg.help: Background/plate color behind overlay text, hex with 8 digits for alpha (`#RRGGBBAA`). Default `#000000B0` = 69% opaque black.
bg.title: Bg

fg.help: Text color for overlays, hex `#RRGGBB`. Default `#FFFFFF` (white).
fg.title: Fg

font_size.help: Base font size in pixels for overlay text. Default 42. Scale it up for very wide posters. Per-element overrides live in the Overlay editor.
font_size.title: Font Size

margin.description: Pixel margin from the poster edge.
margin.help: Distance (in pixels) between the overlay and the poster edge. Default 20.
margin.title: Margin

position.description: Base corner/edge for the overlay block.
position.help: Default anchor for overlay elements (e.g. `top_left`, `bottom_left`). Individual elements can override this. The fine-grained layout is managed in the Overlay editor (later S9 session).
position.title: Position

radius.description: Corner radius of the backdrop plate (pixels).
radius.help: Corner rounding (pixels) of the semi-transparent plate behind overlay text. Default 12. 0 = sharp corners.
radius.title: Radius

format_rules.description: Per-category K9 overlay detection rules; empty uses K9 defaults.
format_rules.help: Conditional badge detection (K9): resolution/HDR/audio badges are drawn only when an enabled rule matches the item's MediaStreams; no match means no badge. Leave empty to use built-in Kometa-style defaults. Editable in the Overlay editor's Format rules section: toggle a rule on/off or change its priority; conditions and labels are read-only.
format_rules.title: Format Rules

logo_packs.description: Overlay logo packs in priority order (first match wins).
logo_packs.help: Logo sources for rating badges and resolution/HDR/audio image badges, in priority order — the first pack that has an image for a badge wins. `kometa` uses the pack installed via the Install-Kometa-logos button into `<config>/assets/logos/kometa/`. `custom` reads flat files from `<config>/assets/logos/<key>.png` (your own artwork). Leave empty (or use no sources) to draw text pills only. Missing images always fall back to the current text pill.
logo_packs.title: Logo Packs

profiles.description: Named overlay profiles; libraries reference one by name.
profiles.help: Named overlay profiles (K8/D2). A library's `overlay_profile` points at one of these names. Each profile may set: `style` (a full style document merged over `overlays.style`), `format_rules` (per-category K9 rule overrides merged over `overlays.format_rules`), and `elements` (the overlay element list, falling back to the library's `overlays` when absent). Libraries with no profile get no overlays. YAML-editable; unknown keys are an error.
profiles.title: Profiles

stream_batch_size.description: Items per /Items?Ids= batch when fetching MediaStreams.
stream_batch_size.help: Apply/plan fetches MediaStreams in batches of this many item IDs per `GET /Items?Ids=a,b,c` request instead of one request per item. Default 50 (1-500). N items use ceil(N/batch) requests.
stream_batch_size.title: Stream Batch Size

style.help: Global defaults for the overlay compositor (position, margin, font size, colors, radius). Per-element layout lives under ``user_styles`` and is edited in the Overlay editor. The compositor renders from the original poster so re-runs never stack (SPEC override O7).

user_styles.description: User-edited overlay style documents, keyed by name.
user_styles.help: Named overlay styles saved from the Overlay editor. Each value is a full style document (base settings + per-element overrides); presets are always cloned into this map before editing so built-in presets stay read-only.
user_styles.title: User Styles

PathMapping.description: One Jellyfin-path -> local-path translation (SPEC override O6).

jellyfin.description: Path as seen from Jellyfin (starts with its media root).
jellyfin.help: The media path *as Jellyfin sees it*, e.g. `/media`. Every Jellyfin path Finmeta touches is translated through this mapping before it is read from or written to disk. A path with no mapping is skipped with an error (never guessed).
jellyfin.title: Jellyfin

local.description: Corresponding path on the local filesystem.
local.help: The local path that maps to the Jellyfin path, e.g. `/media` in the container or `/work/fixture/library` in dev. This is where sidecar files (NFOs, artwork) are written.
local.title: Local

PathMapping.title: PathMapping

filter.help: Optional constraints (year range, min rating, genres) selecting which items fill the playlist. Empty = all items in the library.

library.description: Library the playlist is built from.
library.help: The library (key from `libraries`) whose items fill the playlist. Must reference a configured library.
library.title: Library

limit.description: Maximum number of items in the playlist.
limit.help: Cap on how many items go into the playlist. Default 20.
limit.title: Limit

name.help: The name shown in Jellyfin for this playlist. Must be unique among playlists you define.
name.title: Name

sort.help: How items are ordered in the playlist, e.g. `rating_desc` (best first), `rating_asc`, `year_desc`, `year_asc`, `title`. Default `rating_desc`.
sort.title: Sort

user.description: Jellyfin username the playlist is created for.
user.help: The Jellyfin user the playlist is created under. Must exist in Jellyfin. Used for user-scoped playlists.
user.title: User

PosterRotation.description:
Automatically reshuffle+reapply the poster of a library's top-rated
items on a cron schedule (S9d6), so the best items' artwork visibly
changes over time instead of staying static forever.

Only has a visible effect once ``artwork_selection`` for the library
resolves to ``random_top_n`` with ``top_n >= 2`` (there must be more than
one candidate poster to rotate between) -- enabling this field forces
that via ``_LibraryBase._apply_poster_rotation_requirements`` below,
rather than silently doing nothing.

cron.description: Cron expression for when the rotation runs.
cron.help: A 5-field cron expression, default `0 4 * * 0` (Sundays 04:00). Same syntax as the Schedules tab.
cron.title: Cron

enabled.description: Rotate the poster of this library's top-rated items weekly (or per `cron`).
enabled.help: When on, a scheduled job reshuffles and reapplies the poster of this library's `item_count` highest-rated items on the `cron` schedule. Off by default -- opt in per library.
enabled.title: Enabled

item_count.description: How many of the library's highest-rated items get rotated.
item_count.help: The N highest-rated items (by Jellyfin's `CommunityRating`) in this library whose poster gets reshuffled+reapplied each run. Default 5.
item_count.title: Item Count

PosterRotation.title: PosterRotation

action.description: What the schedule does: plan (dry-run) or apply.
action.help: `plan` = build the WritePlan without writing anything (safe, default); `apply` = actually write files and call the Jellyfin API. `apply` is refused while `dry_run` is true.
action.title: Action

cron.description: Cron expression for when the schedule runs.
cron.help: A 5-field cron expression, e.g. `0 4 * * *` (daily at 04:00) or `0 2 * * 1` (Mondays 02:00). Standard cron minute/hour/day/month/weekday fields.
cron.title: Cron

libraries.help: Restrict the run to these libraries (keys from `libraries`). Empty = run against all configured libraries.
libraries.title: Libraries

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the Jellyfin API key.
api_key_env.help: Only the *name* of the env var that holds your Jellyfin API key (never the key itself). The key is read from that env var or from Settings. Changing this name does not change where the key comes from — it just renames the lookup.
api_key_env.title: Api Key Env

base_path.description: Optional URL prefix when Jellyfin is behind a reverse proxy.
base_path.help: Prefix added to every API path when Jellyfin is served under a sub-path by a reverse proxy. With `url: http://home.example.com` and `base_path: /jellyfin`, Finmeta calls `http://home.example.com/jellyfin/System/Info`. Leave empty for the normal case; a leading slash is optional and is normalized.
base_path.title: Base Path

timeout.description: Per-request timeout for the Jellyfin client, in seconds.
timeout.help: How long to wait, in seconds, for each Jellyfin request before giving up (default 30). Raise it for a slow or distant server.
timeout.title: Timeout

url.help: The address of your Jellyfin server, e.g. `http://jellyfin:8096` or `http://192.168.1.10:8096`. Inside a container, `http://localhost:8096` points at the container itself, not your Jellyfin — use the LAN IP, or the container/service name when Finmeta and Jellyfin share a Docker network. A trailing slash is stripped automatically. Changing this (or base_path / verify_ssl / timeout) hot-reloads the client — no restart. Reverse-proxy example: `url: http://home.example.com` with `base_path: /jellyfin` calls `http://home.example.com/jellyfin/System/Info`.
url.title: Url

verify_ssl.description: Verify TLS certificates for https connections.
verify_ssl.help: Verify the server's TLS certificate for `https` URLs (default on). Turn off only for a self-signed cert you trust (e.g. a home reverse proxy); then the connection is not protected from tampering.
verify_ssl.title: Verify Ssl

fanart.help: Settings for the fanart.tv source (enabled + which env var holds the key). See the fanart.tv help in the External services tab.

field_sources.description: Per-rating-field precedence: an ordered list of provider names. The first provider that has a non-None value wins. Valid field names: rating_imdb, rating_rt_critic, rating_rt_audience, rating_metacritic, rating_tmdb, rating_trakt, rating_letterboxd. Valid provider names: mdblist, omdb, imdb_datasets, jellyfin, tmdb.
field_sources.help: Which provider supplies each rating value, in priority order. The first provider in the list that has a value for the item wins. Defaults: `rating_imdb: [mdblist, omdb, imdb_datasets, jellyfin]`, `rating_rt_critic: [mdblist, omdb, jellyfin]`, `rating_metacritic: [mdblist, omdb]`, `rating_tmdb: [mdblist, tmdb]`, and `rating_rt_audience`, `rating_trakt`, `rating_letterboxd` all default to `[mdblist]`. Reorder these in the Rating sources tab; only providers that can supply a rating appear for that field.
field_sources.title: Field Sources

imdb_datasets.help: Settings for the IMDb bulk-dataset ratings source (enabled). No key — it downloads IMDb's public title.ratings dataset. See the IMDb datasets help.

local.help: Settings for the local on-disk artwork source (enabled + path). Use this to supply your own artwork files.

mdblist.help: Settings for the MDBList ratings source (enabled + which env var holds the key). See the MDBList help in the External services tab.

omdb.help: Settings for the OMDb ratings source (enabled + which env var holds the key). See the OMDb help in the External services tab.

precedence.description: Order in which sources are consulted; first hit wins.
precedence.help: For each artwork kind, sources are tried in this order and the first one that has a candidate wins. Default `[local, fanart, tmdb]`. Only names that are configured may appear.
precedence.title: Precedence

tmdb.help: Settings for the TMDb source (enabled + which env var holds the key). See the TMDb help in the External services tab.

StatusOverlayConfig.description: S9g1/K7a: TV show status (from Sonarr) -- overlay element + optional collections.

collection_names.description: Override the default collection name for a status (status key -> name).
collection_names.help: Only used when `create_collections` is on. Maps a status key (e.g. `new_season_soon`, `returning`, `ended`) to a custom Jellyfin collection name; any status not listed here uses a title-cased default (e.g. `new_season_soon` -> 'New Season Soon').
collection_names.title: Collection Names

create_collections.description: Also create a Jellyfin collection per status (e.g. 'New Season Soon').
create_collections.help: Off by default. When on, every TV show with a computed status (see the `status` overlay element) is added to a Jellyfin collection named after that status -- one collection per status value present, created the same way as `collections` (SPEC override O1, no collection.nfo). Override a status's collection name via `collection_names`.
create_collections.title: Create Collections

date_style.description: How a dated status (e.g. 'NEW SEASON') shows its date on the badge.
date_style.help: `relative` (default): TODAY/TOMORROW for the next two days, the weekday name for days 2-6 out, else DD.MM. `classic`: always DD.MM, regardless of how far away the date is.
date_style.title: Date Style

recent_days.description: How many days a just-aired premiere/finale still counts as 'just happened'.
recent_days.help: Controls the *_aired statuses (new_season_started, season_finale_aired, final_episode_aired): an episode that aired more than this many days ago no longer counts as 'just happened' and the show falls back to a plain status (returning/ended) instead. Default 14.
recent_days.title: Recent Days

StatusOverlayConfig.title: StatusOverlayConfig

filter.description: Optional filter applied to the library items.
filter.help: Optional constraints (year range, min rating, genres) applied on top of the library. Required for `filter`-type collections; ignored for `tmdb_collection`.

library.description: Library this collection is built from.
library.help: The library (key from `libraries`) whose items are used to build this collection. Must reference a configured library.
library.title: Library

min_items.description: Minimum matched items before the collection is created.
min_items.help: Only create the collection if at least this many library items match it. Default 2 (avoids near-empty collections).
min_items.title: Min Items

name.help: The name shown in Jellyfin for this collection. Must be unique among collections you define.
name.title: Name

type.help: Fixed value `tmdb_collection`. Builds a Jellyfin collection from a TMDb collection (films that share a TMDb collection id). Needs at least `min_items` matches.
type.title: Type

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the TMDb API key.
api_key_env.help: Env var name holding your TMDb API v3 key (not the key itself). Set the key via that env var or in Settings. Get one at https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api.
api_key_env.title: Api Key Env

enabled.description: Enable TMDb as a metadata/artwork source.
enabled.help: Turn TMDb on/off. TMDb provides metadata, ratings and most artwork. On by default. Disabling it makes matching/artwork much weaker.
enabled.title: Enabled

TrendingConfig.description: S9g2/K7b: trending collections + optional TOP 10 rank overlay, via MDBList.

lists.description: MDBList lists to mirror as Jellyfin collections.
lists.help: Requires `sources.mdblist.enabled` and a saved MDBList API key (the `mdblist_key` secret). Each entry is one public MDBList list, mirrored into one Jellyfin collection of matched library items; optionally also tags its top 10 with a rank for the `trending_rank` overlay element.
lists.title: Lists

TrendingConfig.title: TrendingConfig

TrendingListConfig.description: S9g2/K7b: one MDBList list to mirror into a Jellyfin collection.

collection_name.description: Jellyfin collection name to create/sync from this list.
collection_name.help: The Jellyfin collection this list's matched items are added to (SPEC override O1 -- created via the Jellyfin API, no collection.nfo). Only items already present in a managed library and matched by TMDb id are added; items MDBList lists that aren't in your library are skipped (not downloaded -- see K7b).
collection_name.title: Collection Name

limit.description: Max items to pull from the list (0 = the list's own size).
limit.help: Cap how many of the list's (already-ranked) items to fetch. 0 = no cap.
limit.title: Limit

rank_overlay.description: Tag this list's top 10 matched items with their rank for the trending_rank element.
rank_overlay.help: When on, items ranked 1-10 on this list get a '#<rank>' value for the `trending_rank` overlay element (e.g. a TOP 10 badge). Off by default. When more than one list has this on, the FIRST list (in config order) that ranks an item wins.
rank_overlay.title: Rank Overlay

url.description: Public MDBList list URL, e.g. https://mdblist.com/lists/<user>/<slug>.
url.help: The list's public page URL on mdblist.com (open the list on mdblist.com and copy the address bar). MDBList's own 'Popular Lists' page has ready-made Trakt Trending Movies/TV Shows mirrors you can point at directly.
url.title: Url

TrendingListConfig.title: TrendingListConfig

backdrop.help: Write a show `fanart.jpg`/backdrop (16:9). Off by default.
backdrop.title: Backdrop

episode_thumbs.help: Write a thumbnail image for each episode. Off by default; noisy and large for long-running shows.
episode_thumbs.title: Episode Thumbs

logo.help: Write a show `logo.png` (transparent title logo). Off by default. Very useful for TV shows.
logo.title: Logo

poster.help: Write a show `poster.jpg` (2:3). Off by default.
poster.title: Poster

season_posters.help: Write `seasonXX.poster.jpg` for each season. Off by default.
season_posters.title: Season Posters

artwork.help: TV artwork options (poster, backdrop, logo, season_posters, episode_thumbs). See each option's help.

artwork_selection.description: Per-library automatic artwork selection (None = inherit global).
artwork_selection.help: Override the global `artwork_selection` for this library. Leave unset to inherit the global preset/top_n.

artwork_write_method.description: Per-library artwork write method override (None = inherit global).
artwork_write_method.help: `sidecar` is the only write method (see the global `artwork_write_method` for why `jellyfin_api` was removed 2026-10-26) -- this override can no longer actually differ from the global setting. Kept only so an older config.yml with this key already set keeps loading.
artwork_write_method.title: Artwork Write Method

enabled.description: Whether this library is managed at all.
enabled.help: Turn this library on/off. Libraries that appear in Jellyfin but are not mentioned in config stay off and untouched (anime libraries included). Default `false` so a newly added Jellyfin library never gets written to until you explicitly enable it.
enabled.title: Enabled

metadata.help: Controls whether and what metadata NFO is written for this library (enabled + which fields). See Metadata help.

overlay_profile.description: Name of the overlay profile applied to this library's items.
overlay_profile.help: Which named overlay profile (from `overlays.profiles`) is applied to this library's items during plan/apply. A profile supplies the overlay element list plus per-element style/format-rule overrides. Leave unset for no overlays at all. Unknown names are a config error.
overlay_profile.title: Overlay Profile

overlays.description: Deprecated: overlay element names (use overlay_profile instead).
overlays.help: Deprecated (S9d4c). Kept only so older configs keep loading: at config-load time, a non-empty list here with no profile (or a profile with no `elements`) is migrated into an auto-generated profile `<library>-auto` holding this list, assigned via `overlay_profile`. From then on only the profile is read. Set `overlay_profile` + `overlays.profiles` directly instead of this list in new configs.
overlays.title: Overlays

poster_rotation.description: Scheduled poster reshuffle for this library's top-rated items.
poster_rotation.help: Off by default. See PosterRotation help.

theme_song.description: Copy the show's theme song from the local asset dir.
theme_song.help: Place a theme song for each show, sourced from the local asset directory only (v1 does not download from YouTube — see SPEC override O2). Off by default.
theme_song.title: Theme Song

type.help: Fixed value `tvshows`. Tells Finmeta this library is a TV library and selects the TV artwork options.
type.title: Type

artwork_language_fallback.help: Ordered fallback languages for artwork, e.g. `[en, null]`. A `null` entry means 'prefer textless artwork'. Finmeta walks this list and uses the first language that has a matching image.
artwork_language_fallback.title: Artwork Language Fallback

artwork_selection.help: How Finmeta automatically chooses among artwork candidates (preset + top_n). A library can override this under `libraries.<name>.artwork_selection`.

artwork_write_method.description: How poster/backdrop/logo/landscape artwork is written (metadata NFO and theme songs are always sidecar files; Jellyfin has no API for either).
artwork_write_method.help: `sidecar` -- the only write method, and the only value this field accepts. Writes poster.jpg/backdrop.jpg/etc. directly into the media folder next to the video file. The alternative this field used to also accept, `jellyfin_api` (uploads straight to Jellyfin via `POST /Items/{id}/Images/{type}`, never touching the media folder), was removed 2026-10-26: confirmed against a real library that Jellyfin's own scanning keeps re-asserting a local poster/backdrop/logo/fanart file as authoritative over an API-uploaded one, so it could never reliably override an item whose media folder already had local artwork -- which is to say, most real libraries. Field kept (rather than removed outright) only so an older config.yml with this key already set to `sidecar` keeps loading.
artwork_write_method.title: Artwork Write Method

backup_retention_days.description: Days a superseded backup copy spends in trash before permanent deletion.
backup_retention_days.help: S9d5: every file write backs up the previous version (SPEC override O5). Without cleanup these pile up forever. On each apply, Finmeta moves every superseded backup copy (i.e. not the very first one ever made for a path, and not the most recent one) into `<config>/trash/`; a trash entry is then permanently deleted once it has sat there for this many days. The FIRST backup ever made for a path (the true pre-Finmeta original, needed for overlay re-renders to never stack badges -- SPEC override O7, and for a full undo) and the MOST RECENT backup (needed to undo the latest run) are never touched, regardless of this setting. Set to `0` to disable cleanup and keep every backup forever.
backup_retention_days.title: Backup Retention Days

collection_presets.help: Ids of built-in preset collections to keep active (e.g. `adaptive_seasonal`, `top_popular_movies`) — see the Collections tab for the full catalog. `adaptive_seasonal` drives a whole calendar of holiday collections (Valentine's Day, Mother's/Father's Day, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas), each only present in Jellyfin during its own window and deleted automatically outside it (recreated next time it's active); chart presets (Top 50 Popular, Highest Rated) are always kept in sync. Applies automatically to every enabled library of the matching type — no per-library selection needed. Only evaluated on a full (all-libraries) plan/apply, not a single-library or single-item run.
collection_presets.title: Collection Presets

collections.help: Collections Finmeta creates and keeps in sync in Jellyfin. Each is one of `tmdb_collection`, `filter`, or `list`. Created via the Jellyfin API and defined here (no collection.nfo — SPEC override O1).
collections.title: Collections

dry_run.description: Plan-only mode; refuse to write files or call the write API.
dry_run.help: Safety switch. While `true` (the shipped default), apply runs refuse to write anything — the API/CLI only produce a plan. Set to `false` to allow real writes. See `POST /api/runs`.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

language.help: Preferred language for metadata and artwork (BCP-47, e.g. `en-US`, `en-GB`). Default `en-US`.
language.title: Language

libraries.description: Named library profiles (the main config surface).
libraries.help: The libraries Finmeta manages, keyed by a name you choose (e.g. `Movies`, `Shows`). Each has a type, metadata and artwork options, theme song and overlays. Collections/playlists/schedules reference these by name.
libraries.title: Libraries

media_apps.help: Your Sonarr (`media_apps.sonarr`) and Radarr (`media_apps.radarr`) instances. Each has a url, the name of the secret holding its API key, timeout, verify_ssl and enabled. Finmeta is read-only against these — it never adds, edits or deletes anything.

overlays.help: Global defaults for the poster overlay compositor (position, fonts, colors, radius). Per-element layout is managed in the Overlay editor (later S9 session).

path_mappings.help: The set of path mappings used to translate every Jellyfin path to a local path before touching disk (SPEC override O6). An unmapped path is skipped with an error, never guessed.
path_mappings.title: Path Mappings

playlists.help: Playlists Finmeta creates and keeps in sync in Jellyfin. Each picks items from a library by an optional filter, up to a limit, in a chosen sort order.
playlists.title: Playlists

schedules.help: Recurring runs. Each has a cron schedule, an action (plan or apply) and an optional library subset. `apply` is refused while `dry_run` is true.
schedules.title: Schedules

server.help: Where Finmeta's Jellyfin is and which env var holds its API key. See ServerConfig help.

sources.help: Which sources (TMDb, fanart.tv, local, OMDb, MDBList, IMDb datasets) are enabled and in what order they are consulted. See the External services tab and each source's help.

status_overlay.description: TV show status (K7a) settings: recent-days window + optional collections.
status_overlay.help: Settings for the TV show `status` overlay element (computed from Sonarr -- new series, new season soon, upcoming finale, returning, ended, etc.). The element itself is enabled per overlay profile like any other (`elements: [status, ...]`); this section only controls the recent-days window and optional per-status collections.

sync_mode.help: `sync` = add new members *and* remove ones that no longer match (default); `append` = only add, never remove. Applies to collections and playlists.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

trending.help: Lists of MDBList lists mirrored into Jellyfin collections, with an optional TOP 10 rank overlay element (`trending_rank`). Empty by default.
